prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Plum and Mint: page #FCF9FF, text #3D2346, accent #805099, secondary surface #CDF3DF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
